propositions: validate --fix flag is advertised in six places but implemented as a no-op that does nothing, misleading users to follow tool-provided advice that yields no effect
validate and fsck commands serve disjoint purposes: fsck checks store integrity via bytes and git refs while validate checks reduced ticket semantics, but documentation incorrectly conflates them
removing --fix from validate requires deletion across all advertisement sites and refactoring runtime hints to direct users to doctor command instead
passing --fix to validate must be refused with exit code 1 and Unknown option error rather than silently accepted
docs/cli-reference.md must be regenerated via gen_cli_reference.py and not hand-edited to avoid CI drift gate rejection
docs/chatgpt-agent-guide.md:91 sends agents to validate for store integrity checks when fsck is the correct command
